g.text: Where Claude is trained vs where it is served
Anthropic trains on three chip platforms. A Bedrock request is served on AWS.
over 1M Trainium2 chips train and serve Claude
up to 1M TPUs, over 1 GW, from 2026
the third platform in Anthropic's mix
AWS GPU instances run NVIDIA GPUs
AWS doesn't say which GPU generation serves Claude
Memory per accelerator (HBM on the package)
Trainium2 96 GB · NVIDIA H100 80 GB · H200 141 GB · B200 192 GB
trn2.48xlarge: 16 Trainium2 = 1.5 TiB HBM · Trn2 UltraServer: 64 chips = 6 TiB, linked by NeuronLink
p5en.48xlarge: 8 × H200 = 1,128 GB HBM, linked by NVLink
Training never happens in ap-southeast-2. Your Region only runs inference.
